quote: lunsch siglia ella che la media da sia gruppa da scolars?
surrounding_context: Dunna Infantini exercitescha il sigl en lung cun ses sis scolars. I dat ils suandants resultats: 2p 3 𝑚𝑚 86 𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐, 212 𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐, 4 𝑚𝑚 9 𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐, 3.4 𝑚𝑚, 2 𝑚𝑚 44 𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐 𝑒𝑒 3.29 𝑚𝑚. La scolasta, dunna Infantini, fa in sigl da 4𝑚𝑚 4 𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐. Quant pli lunsch siglia ella che la media da sia gruppa da scolars?
observed_sense_gloss: gruppa da scolars: an ordinary group of pupils
review_note: The question compares the teacher's jump with the mean of her pupil group. This is the ordinary collection-of-people sense explicitly excluded by T39-S1.

surrounding_context: Flurina va a las 08:29 cun ses e-bike tar sia onda, nua ch'ella arriva a las 10:01. Ella ha cuntanschì ina sveltezza media da 30 km/h.
